description: This file contains the implementation of CanvasWindowController, a Swift class managing a window with a WebView in a macOS application. It handles loading URLs, managing a WebKit bridge for communication, observing file changes, and managing UI presentation details for a canvas-based interface.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: A macOS window controller managing a WebView for displaying and interacting with a canvas, with support for URL loading, JavaScript bridge, file watching, and presentation handling.

methods.name: applyPreferredPlacement
methods.description: Sets the preferred placement for the canvas window.

methods.name: showCanvas
methods.description: Displays the canvas window, optionally loading a specific path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a URL or local file or canvas route into the WebView.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display with optional title and subtitle.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies the current debug status settings to the WebView.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a local file URL into the WebView.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript string in the WebView and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of the WebView as a PNG image and saves to a path.

methods.name: shouldAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Determines if the WebView should auto-navigate based on the current target and last auto-target.
